label: Cyberpunk 2020
description: High tech, low life. Street samurais, eddies and corps in Night City.
tldr: Cyberpunk 2020 — dexterity-first gunplay. Combat is d10-vs-target-number (higher is better, 10s and 11s are the only hits, 1 = fumble). Seven attributes 1–10 with a per-attribute die pool; cyberware costs 'EDD' (money) and 'heat' — the more chrome, the closer to cyberpsychosis. Skills are bought in tiers, no fixed spell lists; your netdeck, chrome and contacts ARE your build.

links.data_api: no public data API — local profile only

races.Night City: Born inside the sprawl between the corps and the gutter. You know every shortcut, every gang tag, and exactly when to cross the street.
races.Badlands Nomad: Raised on the open road beyond the city wall. You read the horizon like other people read maps, and you learned to fix anything with your hands.
races.Arasaka Corporate: Wore a suit before you could walk. The megacorp gave you a future — as long as you stayed useful and never asked where the money came from.
races.Militech Veteran: The conflicts left you a soldier's instincts and a stack of scars, plus a few contacts who still answer your calls.
races.Street Kid: The streets raised you. You survive on hustle, nerve, and an eye for opportunity in the cracks the corps ignore.

classes.Solo: A gun for hire who has replaced fear with reflex. Solos live on the edge of a trigger and know the worth of any target in eddies.
classes.Netrunner: You dive the Net behind your eyes and pull strings in the machine. Data is your weapon, the ICE your enemy, and a bad link your death.
classes.Techie: You build, break, and rebuild the chrome everyone else depends on. Give you junk and time, and you'll return a weapon.
classes.MedTech: The city's forgotten fixer of flesh. You patch bullet holes and stitch cyberware between people who have no one else to call.
classes.Fixer: You know everyone and everything moves through you. Information and introductions are your stock in trade — and you always take a cut.
classes.Nomad: Family is the convoy, home is a moving target. You keep wheels turning and borders burning behind you.
classes.Cop: Either the last honest badge in Night City or another paid-off uniform. You keep the thin line — or collect for looking the other way.
classes.Corporate: Power is a ladder greased in blood and money. You climb, you manage, you survive the boardroom's friendly knives.
classes.Rockerboy: Your voice cuts through the static and the lies. You're a spark the city can't ignore — or a riot waiting for a stage.
classes.Media: You chase the truth with a camera and a deadline. The story is worth more than your safety, and the whole city is your beat.
